trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum trophy, so it unlocks once every other trophy on this list has been earned. There is nothing extra to do beyond finishing the story, the missables, the collectibles, and the activities. Use the roadmap view to work through the stages in order and this will pop at the end.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play through the story until you reach the mission called Gone Fishing, then complete it. The trophy pops as soon as that mission is finished. Because it is part of the main story, you cannot really miss it if you keep playing.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish everything in Chapter 1 of the story. The trophy unlocks automatically when the chapter ends and the game moves you on. Just keep following the main missions and it will come naturally.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 of the main story. Keep working through the story missions in order and the trophy will unlock at the end of the chapter. No side content is needed for this one.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3 until it is fully complete. The trophy appears when the chapter wraps up and the story moves forward. Stick to the main mission path and you will get it along the way.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 of the story. This unlocks as part of normal story progression once the chapter is done. Keep going with the main missions and there is nothing special to hunt down.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story to earn this gold trophy. It marks the end of the main campaign, so expect it only after all the earlier chapters are done. After this, you can keep playing to clean up everything else.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission called Breakfast Run when it becomes available. This trophy can be missed, so grab it as soon as it appears instead of putting it off. If you move too far through the story without doing it, you may lose the chance.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Play the story mission called The Cartel Heist and see it through to the end. The trophy unlocks when the heist is completed. It sits on the main story path, so normal play will bring you to it.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission called Child's Play. This one is missable, so do it as soon as it shows up rather than saving it for later. Playing past its window can lock you out of the trophy for that run.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission called Headliners. Finishing that mission is all the trophy asks for. It comes through regular story progress, so keep following the main thread.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Play through the mission called VCIA Takedown until it is complete. The trophy pops at the end of that mission. Since it is part of the story, you will reach it by continuing the campaign.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission called Operation Savage Glory. That is the whole requirement: finish the mission and the trophy is yours. It arrives through normal story progression.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the game, which means finishing the story and everything else the completion tracker counts. This is a long-term goal, so treat it as the capstone of the activities stage. Keep an eye on your completion percentage and chip away at whatever is left.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts in total. Stunts add up over time, so work through them as you explore and drive around Leonida. Check your stats now and then to see how close you are to 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity at least once. You do not need to master any of them; a single attempt at each kind is enough. As new activities open up, give each one a go so none are left untried.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge. Silver or bronze results will not count, so replay any challenge where you fell short of gold. Practice each challenge until your scores are good enough across the board.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location that offers one. A win at a single spot is not enough; you need first place everywhere. Work through the locations one by one and keep retrying any race you lose.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Repeating the same race over and over will not help, because each win needs to be a different race. Spread your effort across the race events you find until you have twenty distinct wins.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take on Cal in a fishing challenge and beat him. Simply fishing on your own is not enough; the win has to come against Cal in that challenge. If you lose the first time, try again until you come out ahead.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play an arcade game through to completion. Starting a game and quitting early will not count, so see one through to the end. Any arcade game that you fully complete should satisfy the requirement.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Work through Andy's missions until you reach his final one, then complete it. The trophy is tied to that last mission rather than the earlier ones in his strand. Keep following Andy's storyline until it wraps up.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's strand. You will need to do his earlier missions first to reach the last one. The trophy unlocks when that final mission is finished.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand by completing his final mission. Play through his earlier missions to unlock the last one. The trophy pops once that final mission is done.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers spread across Leonida. A strand means the full set of missions for one stranger, not just a single task. Keep meeting strangers and finishing their storylines until eight strands are complete.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Work through his earlier missions to reach the end of his strand. Finishing that last mission earns the trophy.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand by completing his final mission. Do his earlier missions first so the last one becomes available. The trophy unlocks at the end of that final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. Each spot only needs to be used once, but you have to find them all. Sweep the map area by area so no spot is left behind.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. This is tied to Bret's request rather than general hunting, so follow what he asks for. Bring down the unique animal he wants and the trophy should unlock.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Finishing a set means collecting every card that belongs to it, and you need three full sets in total. Keep gathering cards as you explore and check which sets are closest to done.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations. Each location counts once, so keep moving to new places instead of repeating the same spot. It is a slow grind, so tick locations off steadily as you travel.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges cover lots of different tasks, so mix them up and keep clearing new ones. Check your progress regularly to see how many you still need.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Build up a 4 star Wanted Level while with your partner, then lose it and escape the heat. The key part is shaking off that high wanted level together rather than getting caught. Plan an escape route before you draw that much attention.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level in between. The wanted level has to stay active across all three robberies, so keep the pressure on and move quickly from shop to shop. If the heat drops before the third robbery, start the run again.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Each new vehicle you encounter adds to the count, so keep an eye out for ones you have not seen yet. Exploring widely and trying different vehicles will push the total up over time.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. All five takedowns need to happen within that one activation, so wait for a moment with plenty of enemies around. If you only get a few, try again on the next group.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA when the opportunity comes up. This trophy can be missed, so take the chance as soon as it appears instead of playing past it. If the moment passes, you may not get another shot at it in that run.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is deliberately vague: 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos.' It points at doing something involving Rhinos, so experiment with Rhinos when you encounter them. Try spending time in one and see what the game counts toward the trophy. If nothing pops right away, keep using Rhinos in different situations until it does.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at any point. A loud or spotted robbery will not count, so approach it quietly and stay unseen. If you get detected, break off and try the robbery again cleanly.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape after each one. Getting caught during a robbery means that attempt does not count, so plan your getaway every time. Work through the vaults one by one until all five are done.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and then escape. The escape matters as much as the robbery itself, so do not get caught afterward. Once you are clear with the take, the trophy should unlock.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. That means uncovering the whole state rather than sticking to a few familiar areas. Travel widely and fill in the map until every part has been visited.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. One gang is not enough; every gang needs at least one of its operations robbed. Keep track of which gangs you have hit so none are missed.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach when you get the chance. This trophy can be missed, so take the moment as soon as it is offered rather than rushing past it. Once that window closes, it may not come back in the same run.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style when the opportunity arises. This one is missable, so seize it the moment it appears instead of leaving it for later. Playing past the scene can lock the trophy out for that run.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. The trophy is about completing what happens there rather than just visiting. Head to that bowling alley and see the activity through to the end.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description only says 'A partnership with mass appeal,' so the exact trigger is kept vague. This trophy can be missed, so pay attention to partnership opportunities as they appear and take them when they show up. Do not put off anything that looks like it could be this moment, or the chance may pass.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: The description is simply 'Choices made (for better or worse).' It suggests the trophy follows from choices you make while playing, whatever the outcome. Keep playing and making decisions as they come up, and the trophy should follow from those choices.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The description only says 'Second time's the charm,' hinting that something needs a second attempt. This trophy can be missed, so when a situation offers another try, take it rather than moving on. Skipping the second chance may lose the trophy for that run.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The description just asks 'What the hell just happened?' so the trigger is intentionally mysterious. This trophy can be missed, so stay alert for strange one-off moments and engage with them when they appear. If you rush past an odd event, the chance may be gone for that run.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by. That means taking targets down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle rather than on foot. Line up a group, drive past, and land the melee hits as you go.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Keep feeding Marked Bills to your contacts and let the earnings add up over time. This is a money grind, so check your total now and then to see how close you are.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops. Purchases from every shop count toward the same running total, so normal shopping adds up. If you are short near the end, buy bigger items to push the total over the line.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase every garage property. Owning most of them is not enough; the trophy needs all of them bought. Save up money and buy each garage property as it becomes available.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Each vehicle you register counts once, so work through ten different ones. Keep registering as you get access to more vehicles until you reach ten.
